protocol.mode: fake-quant simulation, both methods (PixArt has no nunchaku support; same protocol as SVDQuant paper's PixArt numbers)
protocol.format: NVFP4 (E2M1 g16 + fp8 e4m3 micro-scales), W4A4, rank-32 low-rank branch
protocol.svdquant: deepcompressor native pipeline, official pixart-sigma.yaml + svdquant/nvfp4.yaml (smooth grid-search + 100-iter lowrank + calib_range; sample_batch_size 32 for 32GB VRAM)
protocol.absorb: H-SVD basis + GPTQ + down-absorb; skips aligned incl. cross-attn KV fp16 (attn_add)
